name: @playform/hook-dsh-search-suggester
description: The search-suggester hook: a DeepSeek Harness plugin that hooks the tools/post-execute waterfall and, when a search-class call (grep, glob, read, or a search-shaped bash) matches one of the ten intent kinds (Version, Path, Ledger, Config, Dependency, Test, Symbol, Doc, Usage, Owner), prepends ONE labeled additionalContexts note naming the likely target set - the standard locations where that intent lives in this repo - BEFORE the model burns the searches. Deterministic: no LLM in the hot path, a compiled rule table over the call and the last 8 calls, a confidence gate (default 0.75, 0.85 for the destructive intents), at most 7 candidates each with a stated reason, a cooldown, a dedupe, a per-turn cap, and an explicit abstention path - every abstention a ledger line (Documentation/Plans/SEARCH-SUGGESTER-PLUGIN.md).
